web_fixture.title: Live error reference - Otterbourne
web_fixture.snippet: OB-1130 (settlement window closed) is cleared by retrying the request after 90 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Live error reference

Otterbourne API errors, reviewed 2026-04-08.

| code | meaning | prescribed client action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| OB-1002 | unsupported currency for the account | retry after 10 seconds, or fix the currency |
| OB-1130 | settlement window closed for today | retry the same request after 90 seconds |
| OB-1188 | account under review | stop retrying, contact the account team |

The action column is the behaviour this reference prescribes for automated
clients on the live platform.

web_fixture.title: Sandbox error reference - Otterbourne
web_fixture.snippet: Sandbox codes mirror the live codes, but OB-1130 clears after 5 seconds.
web_fixture.content:
# Sandbox error reference

Otterbourne sandbox, reviewed 2026-04-08.

Sandbox codes match the live codes, but sandbox timers are shortened so that an
integration fails fast while it is being tested.

| code | sandbox action |
| --- | --- |
| OB-1002 | retry after 1 second |
| OB-1130 | retry after 5 seconds |
| OB-1188 | stop retrying |
